description: This file defines a Lua module implementing an HTTP filter class 'XFilterDrop' to handle 'X-Sendfile' headers in a web server context, particularly for lighttpd. It includes methods to create filter instances, process content by dropping input, and handle 'X-Sendfile' headers to serve files directly.

classes.name: XFilterDrop
classes.description: A Lua class that drops all incoming data and terminates the request content stream.

methods.name: XFilterDrop:new
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new XFilterDrop instance.

methods.name: XFilterDrop:handle
methods.description: Handles incoming data by dropping it and closing the input stream.
